name: prior-body-read
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
s=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/prior-2014.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20);assert s.returncode==0,s.stderr
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','sources/prior-2014.txt'],input=s.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
print(s.stdout)
